snippet.title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - Winter Update & DLC (New Lords, Co-op & Customisation!)
snippet.description:
Behold and rejoice Sire! Celebrate the festivities and cap off this productive year with the reveal of the second major content update for Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition! 

From co-op trails and map packs, to new Lords and custom editors, the power is in your hands to play how you want and with whomever you want! There’s no better way or time to play this revamped desert hot strategy classic!

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030350/

Join the Discord - https://discord.com/invite/strongholdofficial

Subscribe for Emails - https://www.fireflyworlds.com/signup
